title: Curiosity Has No Limits
statement: Given two sequences a and b of length n-1 with values between 0 and 3, determine if there exists a sequence t of length n with values between 0 and 3 such that for each i, a_i equals the bitwise OR of t_i and t_{i+1}, and b_i equals the bitwise AND of t_i and t_{i+1}. If such a sequence exists, find one.
